Operations · Document verification

Intelligent Document Processing

Our starting point was the difficult pile: blurred scans, unfamiliar formats and cases that a third-party tool had already failed to verify.

evoke · 2025

The problem

The team had to work with real customer documents. A scan could be hard to read, written in another language or laid out in a way the first tool did not expect. The business needed to know when it could rely on a result and when to ask a person.

The decision

We used image processing and optical character recognition to give hard-to-read documents another pass. We combined robotic process automation with Snowflake Cortex AI to classify documents and extract fields. When confidence was low, we routed the case to a person.

What we built

I worked with documents that had failed the first check to identify where a person needed to review the result. The workflow passed structured fields back to the existing process and kept a record for review. We designed it around secure handling and temporary storage.
